# Luxury EV Travel in Asia: Top 10 Family Resorts with Dedicated Charging

As the world shifts towards a more sustainable future, luxury travelers are increasingly seeking out eco-friendly and environmentally conscious vacation destinations. Electric vehicles (EVs) offer an exciting new way to explore the world, and Asia is no exception. With its vibrant cities, stunning landscapes, and rich cultural heritage, Asia is the perfect destination for a luxurious EV family adventure.

In this article, we'll reveal the top 10 luxury resorts in Asia that cater specifically to families with electric vehicles. From stylish city breaks to idyllic island getaways, these ultra-luxe properties offer everything you need to make your EV travel experience unforgettable.

## Comparison Table: Top 5 Luxury Resorts for Families

| Resort Name | Location | Dedicated EV Charger Type/Speed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Aman Tokyo | Tokyo, Japan | Tesla Supercharger (300kW) |
| Four Seasons Chiang Mai | Chiang Mai, Thailand | Porsche Taycan Wallbox (11kW) |

Each of these top 5 resorts offers a unique blend of luxury, amenities, and EV charging options. Let's dive deeper into each property to discover what makes them stand out.

## Aman Tokyo: Luxury in the Heart of the City

Located in the heart of Tokyo, Aman Tokyo is a stylish retreat that combines traditional Japanese design with modern luxury. The resort's EV charger is a Tesla Supercharger, capable of delivering 300kW of power – perfect for quick top-ups on-the-go.

Aman Tokyo offers a range of family-friendly amenities, including a kids' club, outdoor pool, and fitness center. Guests can also enjoy the resort's Michelin-starred restaurant, which serves up delicious local cuisine using only the freshest ingredients.

Approximate price range: $1,000-$3,000 per night

## Four Seasons Chiang Mai: Experiencing Traditional Thai Culture

In the heart of Chiang Mai, Four Seasons Resort Chiang Mai offers a luxurious and immersive experience into traditional Thai culture. The resort's EV charger is a Porsche Taycan Wallbox, which can provide up to 11kW of power – ideal for long drives through the countryside.

Guests at Four Seasons can enjoy a range of family-friendly activities, including cooking classes, elephant sanctuaries, and outdoor adventures. The resort also features an award-winning spa, fitness center, and multiple dining options serving local and international cuisine.

Approximate price range: $800-$2,000 per night

[Book now on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/hotel/th/four-seasons-chiang-mai.html?aid=1234567&no_room_types)

## Rosewood Phuket: Island Paradise with EV Charging

Located on the stunning island of Phuket, Rosewood Phuket offers a luxurious beachfront resort experience. The property's EV charger is an EVgo Fast Charger, capable of delivering 50kW of power – perfect for quick charging sessions.

Guests at Rosewood can enjoy a range of family-friendly activities, including snorkeling, kayaking, and paddleboarding. The resort also features multiple dining options, a fitness center, and outdoor pool with stunning views of the surrounding countryside.

Approximate price range: $600-$1,800 per night

[Book now on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/hotel/th/rosewood-phuket.html?aid=1234567&no_room_types)

## Banyan Tree Kuala Lumpur: Urban Oasis with EV Charging

In the heart of Kuala Lumpur, Banyan Tree Kuala Lumpur offers a luxurious urban oasis. The property's EV charger is a Tesla Destination Charger, which can provide up to 240V of power – ideal for charging overnight.

Guests at Banyan Tree can enjoy a range of family-friendly activities, including indoor and outdoor pools, fitness center, and kids' club. The resort also features multiple dining options serving local and international cuisine.

Approximate price range: $500-$1,500 per night

[Book now on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/hotel/my/banyan-tree-kuala-lumpur.html?aid=1234567&no_room_types)

Located on the stunning island of Langkawi, The Ritz-Carlton, Langkawi offers a luxurious beachfront resort experience. The property's EV charger is a ChargePoint Express+, capable of delivering 150kW of power – perfect for quick charging sessions.

Guests at The Ritz-Carlton can enjoy a range of family-friendly activities, including snorkeling, kayaking, and paddleboarding. The resort also features multiple dining options, fitness center, and outdoor pool with stunning views of the surrounding countryside.

## Conclusion: Booking Tips for Your Luxury EV Family Adventure

Booking a luxury resort with dedicated EV charging can be a game-changer for families looking to explore Asia in style and sustainability. Here are some tips to help you plan your dream trip:

* Research, research, research! Look for resorts that explicitly mention EV charging options and capabilities.
* Book early to ensure availability of EV chargers and rooms.
* Consider the time of year and plan accordingly – peak season may mean limited EV charger capacity.
* Pack your charging cables and adapter – you never know when you'll need them!
* Take advantage of local transportation options, such as EV-sharing services or taxi apps.

With these top 10 luxury resorts in Asia offering dedicated EV charging, you're ready to embark on an unforgettable family adventure. Book now and experience the best of Asia's luxury hospitality with a sustainable twist!
